`df`: report file system space usage.

## Synopsis

<strong>df</strong>

## Description

<strong>df</strong> lists every mounted file system with its size, the space used and the space available, in 1 KiB blocks, the share in use as a percentage, and where it is mounted. The first column names its source (a disk's address, or <strong>tmpfs</strong>).

File systems that report no size, such as <em>/dev</em>, are left out. Arguments are ignored.

## Examples

```text
$ df
Filesystem     1K-blocks  Used ...
```

## Notes

Sizes are always in KiB; there is no <strong>-h</strong> and no file system or path argument.

## See also

<strong>du</strong>(1), <strong>mount</strong>(1), <strong>free</strong>(1)
